scripts.setup: python -m pip install -r requirements.txt && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,magenta "python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 61008" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.start: npm run build && python -m uvicorn app.main:app --app-dir backend --host 0.0.0.0 --port 61008
